title: CLW Recruitment 2026 – Sports Quota Posts
shortInfo: CLW has announced notification for Sports Quota posts. Required qualification: Any Graduate, 12TH, ITI. Last date to apply: 20-08-26.
howToApply: Fill up the application in prescribed format as per Annexure ‘A’ on good quality A-4 size white paper after carefully reading the Employment Notice.
All columns of application should be filled up by the candidate in his/her own handwriting in English/Hindi using blue/black ball point pen.
Applicant should write in his/her own handwriting the sample declaration statement in the space provided in the application form.
Applicant should firmly affix one recent (taken within one month) colour passport size photograph (without cap and/or coloured glass) with white background on the application.
Send 02 (two) photographs duly signed on the back along with the application form and keep at least 05 (five) same photographs for future use.

Enclose legible photocopies (Xerox) of all Certificates in proof of Educational Qualification, Age, Caste Certificate and Proof of Sports Achievements duly attested by any Gazetted Officer or Self-Attested.
Enclose application fee (IPO/Bank DD) as applicable. Applications without application fee will be rejected.
Clearly indicate the Specific Category No., Sports Discipline and Event/Position as given in Para-2.
Write on the top of the envelope: ‘APPLICATION AGAINST SPORTS QUOTA (OPEN ADVERTISEMENT & TALENT SCOUTING) RECRUITMENT FOR THE YEAR 2026-2027’.

Send application by post to: Chief Personnel Officer, Administrative Building, Chittaranjan Locomotive Works, PO- Chittaranjan, District-Paschim Bardhaman, West Bengal, Pin Code-713331. OR drop directly in the Drop Box placed at Dy.GM’s Office/CLW during office hours.
Serving Government Employees should send their applications through proper channel only.
